notes: Classic ESP32: LED outputs 2 to 4 get twice the RMT memory, so Bluetooth and Wi-Fi no longer cause wrong colours on them
Zones are no longer lost when the lights are updated (the update cleared them and the empty layout was saved)
ESP32-C3: up to 4 GIFs at the same time while there is memory (was 2); with 3-4 outputs about 3 KB more free memory
